title: Portland's Famous Bridges & Riverfront History Cruise
includes: 2 Hour Private Tour on Willamette River Portland

policies: Disclaimer: Our top priority is always your safety on the river. While we make every effort to operate tours as advertised, equipment, vessels, staffing, departure times, and schedules may change without prior notice due to mechanical issues, weather, river conditions, or other safety-related factors. To ensure a safe and enjoyable experience, substitutions or schedule adjustments may be necessary. In some cases, tours may not depart at the exact scheduled time due to changing river conditions. If any changes are required, we will notify you as early as reasonably practicable. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Portland from a unique vantage point on the water, cruising beneath its iconic bridges while spotting bald eagles, ospreys, sea lions, and other Pacific Northwest wildlife. 

Led by a US Coast Guard–licensed captain and a Oregon-certified professional guide, each tour blends natural beauty with Portland’s rich 200-year maritime history. Guests may reserve a premium private charter for up to six people for an intimate luxury experience, or join a shared cruise with up to 18 passengers—available daily—for a lively and accessible way to discover the city’s scenic waterways.
